title: Order topology
description: States the topology of an order within a process: the orders it follows. On chain, FigaroCore stores only per-process accumulator state; the edges are carried here and committed via checkoutHash.

fields.name: follows
fields.description: The order hashes (bytes32 hex) of the orders this order follows; at design time, the labels of the agreements the agreement follows. Empty for a root order, or at design time a root agreement.
